functions.name: session.setDescription
functions.description: Sets the short description of your own session.

functions.name: session.setStatus
functions.description: Reports the status of your own session: working, waiting, background, done or idle.

functions.name: statusbar.set
functions.description: Sets a segment of your own session's status bar.

functions.name: statusbar.remove
functions.description: Removes a segment from your own session's status bar.

functions.name: job.add
functions.description: Schedules a shell command in your own session (five-field cron in local time, e.g. 0 2 * * 1-5). Runs while Hangar runs; the result shows in Hangar's job list.

functions.name: job.list
functions.description: Lists the scheduled jobs of your own session with next run and last result.

functions.name: handover.create
functions.description: Hands work over to a new session: task, optional context, project, branch and Git remote. Text and Git references only.

functions.name: handover.get
functions.description: Returns the handover your own session was started with, or null.

functions.name: quota.report
functions.description: Reports Claude Code's 5-hour and weekly usage limit (used by `hangar statusline`).

functions.name: session.info
functions.description: Project and name of an agent session, for other bays.

functions.name: project.list
functions.description: Ids and names of the projects, for other bays.

description.de: Gilt für neue Sessions; je Session im Kopf ihres Feldes umschaltbar.
description.en: Applies to new sessions; switchable per session in the header of its field.

description.de: zsh-Prompt-Syntax, ${vcs_info_msg_0_} ist der Git-Branch. Leer: der Prompt deiner zsh. Gilt für neue und neu gestartete Shells.
description.en: zsh prompt syntax, ${vcs_info_msg_0_} is the git branch. Empty: your zsh's prompt. Applies to new and restarted shells.
